descriptionAr: About the Team The Data Center Build and Delivery team develops the infrastructure that supports OpenAI’s research and products. We work with engineering, construction partners and Operations to deliver safe, reliable facilities at scale. As our portfolio grows, consistent health, safety and environmental practices and clear performance measures help teams identify risks early and deliver sites that are ready to operate. About the Role We are looking for an HSE and Portfolio Performance Lead to strengthen health, safety and environmental oversight and performance management across our data center construction portfolio. You will help sites meet applicable OSHA standards and other HSE requirements, from construction through commissioning and handoff to Operations. You will work across site teams, delivery partners and central functions to establish practical expectations, verify execution and turn portfolio data into action. This role combines hands-on HSE expertise with a portfolio view of contractor performance, risk and operational readiness. Key Responsibilities Develop a consistent portfolio HSE framework covering contractor expectations, risk assessments, field verification, training and escalation, aligned with OpenAI’s EHS standards and relevant specialists. Translate applicable OSHA construction and general-industry requirements into practical site expectations, verify implementation and clarify responsibilities as work transitions from construction to commissioning and Operations. Partner with site and discipline leaders to assess high-risk work, verify critical controls and escalate unsafe conditions, including electrical energization, hazardous energy, lifting, excavation and concurrent construction and operating activities. Establish portfolio performance measures and reporting for HSE outcomes, contractor performance, corrective-action closure and handoff readiness; align definitions with delivery and Operations teams and validate data quality. Lead cross-site performance reviews to identify recurring risks, compare execution against agreed expectations and drive improvement plans with accountable owners, milestones and follow-through. Plan risk-based site assurance and contractor reviews, support incident and near-miss investigations, verify corrective actions and embed lessons learned across the portfolio. Coordinate environmental compliance with site teams and specialists, including waste management, spill prevention, stormwater controls and relevant permit obligations. Define HSE readiness criteria for operational handoff with commissioning and Operations teams, including training, procedures, emergency preparedness, outstanding risks and transfer of required records. Provide clear portfolio updates and recommendations to leadership, surface decisions and resource needs early, and build consistent safety leadership across employees, developers, contractors and service providers. Qualifications Substantial experience leading HSE programs for major construction or complex industrial projects, including oversight across multiple sites or workstreams and responsibility for contractor performance. Working knowledge of applicable OSHA construction and general-industry standards, with experience translating requirements into site controls and verifying implementation across construction, commissioning and operating interfaces. Practical understanding of data center or complex industrial hazards, including electrical safety, hazardous-energy control and high-risk construction activities. Demonstrated ability to build assurance, performance reporting and corrective-action programs and use leading and lagging indicators to improve outcomes. Experience coordinating contractors, site leaders and functional specialists through commissioning and operational handoff, with clear accountability across organizational boundaries. Strong communication and judgment, with the ability to explain technical risk, influence leaders and field teams, and prioritize action in fast-changing environments. Preferred Skills Experience with owner-side HSE oversight across a data center or mission-critical infrastructure portfolio, including developer-led and self-build delivery models. Experience integrating environmental compliance, emergency preparedness and HSE management systems into construction and operational readiness programs. Relevant professional credentials, such as CSP, CIH or an equivalent safety or environmental qualification, or comparable practical expertise. descriptionAr: About the Role Lead OpenAI’s site network infrastructure delivery, coordinating the physical installation and readiness of network systems with the central network team and contracted installation providers. You will be OpenAI’s accountable on-site lead for physical network infrastructure construction and deployment, directing and overseeing the work of general contractors, specialist contractors and other service providers within your discipline. You will combine practical subject-matter depth with hands-on field leadership, managing contracted support to deliver safe, high-quality work to the integrated construction plan. Reporting and scope Report to the Site Construction Manager, who reports through the applicable project-management leadership. Maintain functional alignment with the Network Infrastructure leader and central network engineering team. Own day-to-day discipline execution and contractor performance within the assigned site scope and delegated authority. Coordinate priorities and interfaces through the Site Construction Manager; escalate material cost, schedule, design and acceptance decisions to the appropriate owners. This is a senior site delivery role, suited to an experienced superintendent, supervisor, manager or trade lead. Accountability is for an assigned discipline and site work packages. Site assignment, duration and any shared coverage follow project phase, workload and the staffing plan; effective on-site coverage is required during critical activities. Key Responsibilities Manage structured-cabling contractors, fiber installers, network installation partners and other service providers against the site delivery plan. Translate approved network designs into executable field packages and coordinate bills of materials, material availability and installation sequencing with the central network team. Oversee pathways, duct banks and building-entry interfaces, fiber and copper cabling, racks, patching, labeling and network-equipment installation as applicable. Direct fiber and cabling quality assurance, review test results and traceability, and drive correction of defective or incomplete installations. Coordinate power, cooling, space and physical access readiness with electrical, mechanical and CSLA leads and hardware deployment teams. Coordinate network provisioning, connectivity validation and handover with authorized network engineering and operations teams; maintain accurate installation and as-built records. Set clear contractor deliverables and work priorities; review staffing, progress and quality, identify constraints early, and drive recovery actions through the Site Construction Manager. Provide concise progress and risk reporting, evaluate field impacts of proposed changes, and maintain accountable handoffs between construction partners and OpenAI teams. Qualifications Typically 8–10 years of large-scale data center network deployment, structured cabling, physical-layer installation or infrastructure delivery, with demonstrated field and contractor leadership. Equivalent depth of practical delivery experience will be considered. Strong understanding of physical data center network topologies, network components, bills of materials, rack constraints and installation sequencing; translate approved designs into executable field plans. Deep practical knowledge of fiber and copper plant installation, trunks, panels, terminations, cleaning, labeling and cable administration, including routing diversity and pathway separation. Ability to oversee and assess port-to-port verification, continuity, optical power and optical time-domain reflectometer (OTDR) testing; troubleshoot field installation and mapping discrepancies and verify remediation. Experience defining contractor work packages and statements of work, evaluating delivery requirements, forecasting labor needs and tracking quality, throughput, cost drivers and schedule performance within delegated authority. Experience coordinating deployment prerequisites with engineering and construction teams and completing formal operations handover with as-builts, port maps, test evidence and clear ownership transfer. Comfort with ticket-based execution, change control, incident escalation and documentation workflows that make network installation repeatable and auditable. Demonstrated ability to lead contractors and service providers through changing site conditions, set clear deliverables and acceptance criteria, and resolve performance gaps across organizations without relying on direct reporting authority. Strong written and verbal communication: maintain accurate field records, action and decision logs, and explain technical risks, schedule impacts and recovery options to site leadership, engineers and delivery partners. Sound judgment when information is incomplete: identify assumptions, prerequisites and interfaces, determine what work can proceed within approved authority, and escalate unresolved risks before they affect safety, quality or delivery. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world. This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning. About the Role OpenAI is seeking a Motion Designer to help tell the stories behind our research. You’ll translate complex ideas, emerging capabilities, and the work of our researchers into clear, engaging motion across films, launches, demos, and other communications. Working within the creative team, you’ll partner with Research, Brand, and production teams to shape work from early concepts through final delivery. You’ll help determine what a story needs visually, explore different approaches, and bring those ideas to life through thoughtful design and animation. This is a hands-on role for someone with strong motion craft, curiosity about unfamiliar subjects, and the ability to find a compelling visual approach when the brief is still taking shape. You’ll contribute to how OpenAI’s research is expressed in motion, developing original work and reusable approaches that help the team build on what it learns. In this role, you will: Develop motion concepts for research stories, working with creative partners and subject matter experts to understand the ideas and identify how best to communicate them. Design and produce high-quality 2D and 3D motion for research films, launches, demos, and supporting content. Apply and extend OpenAI’s visual and motion language, balancing consistency with the needs of each story. Take work from visual exploration, storyboards, and animatics through animation, compositing, and final delivery. Collaborate closely with designers, filmmakers, editors, producers, and researchers, bringing a motion perspective into the creative process early. Translate technical or abstract concepts into visual sequences that are accessible to a broad audience while preserving the meaning of the underlying work. Work with producers to scope projects, communicate dependencies, and maintain a high standard of craft as priorities and timelines evolve. Present work clearly, explain creative decisions, and incorporate feedback from creative and technical partners. Develop reusable assets, templates, and workflows where they improve quality and make recurring work easier to produce. You might thrive in this role if you have: 7+ years of experience in motion design across films, campaigns, launches, or other narrative work. A strong portfolio demonstrating design judgment, animation craft, and the ability to carry an idea from concept through finished execution. The ability to explore an open-ended brief, propose a clear creative direction, and refine it through collaboration. Proficiency in After Effects and experience with Cinema 4D or comparable 3D tools, alongside editing and compositing workflows. Comfort working in Figma and sharing work across design and production teams. A strong understanding of typography, composition, timing, rhythm, and visual storytelling. Experience making complex or unfamiliar subjects understandable through design and motion. Experience working with subject matter experts and incorporating technical feedback without losing clarity or creative quality. Curiosity about AI and research, and a willingness to learn enough about a subject to represent it thoughtfully. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises. Given OpenAI’s breakneck shipping cadence and growth – and the expectation that it will only accelerate – our ability to architect automation systems and agentic workflows for scale is central to our ability to maintain exceptional support quality in the face of AGI. This is a vendor leadership role first and foremost: you will drive commercial and operational accountability (SLAs, QBRs, escalation paths, remediation plans), while also building the operating model that enables support to scale without linear headcount growth. You’ll collaborate closely with User Operations teams (e.g., Trust & Safety, Fraud & Risk), Systems/Tooling, Data partners, and Product/PM stakeholders as we launch new workflows and launch and scale new programs. This role is based in Singapore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. 1-2 weeks of travel per quarter may be required. In this role, you will: End-to-end vendor leadership: Own day-to-day oversight, relationship health, and executive-level accountability for multiple support vendors/BPOs. Performance management & remediation: Define and manage SLA/KPI performance expectations, run WBRs/QBRs, identify performance gaps, and drive structured turnaround plans with clear owners and timelines. Escalation and risk management: Serve as the primary escalation point for vendor issues, including incident response, surge events, quality regressions, and continuity risks; ensure vendors have strong operational controls and playbooks. Commercial and operational governance: Partner on contract levers, staffing commitments, service scope changes, and operational cadences; ensure governance mechanisms produce measurable outcomes. Operational reporting and executive narratives: Produce clear, decision-ready reporting on vendor health, capacity risk, and scaling constraints; translate operational signals into recommendations for leadership. You might thrive in this role if you have: 5+ years in vendor/BPO operations management, support operations, or partner performance leadership in a scaled environment. Proven ability to run vendor governance: QBRs, SLA/KPI design, escalation paths, remediation plans, and cross-functional stakeholder management. Awareness of and some experience with workforce planning approaches—e.g., forecasting frameworks, capacity models, staffing strategies, and performance-to-plan systems. across global, multi-site support operations. Strong analytical and operational rigor: comfort working with data to define inputs/assumptions, evaluate tradeoffs, and drive outcomes (you do not need to be a data scientist, but you must be fluent). Familiarity with support tooling and operational systems (e.g., Salesforce Service Cloud or similar), and comfort partnering with Systems/Tooling to implement scalable processes. descriptionAr: About the Team The Strategic Finance team provides financial insights and guidance to support the organization's long-term goals and strategies. We partner across the business to allocate and deploy our resources for the highest impact outcomes. About the Role Our Workloads team under Research focuses on maximizing the performance and efficiency of model inference, enabling OpenAI to develop and deploy frontier AI models at scale. We are hiring a senior Strategic Finance business partner to work closely with our Workloads team to drive improvements in model serving efficiency and compute economics. You will partner directly with researchers and engineers to identify and prioritize high-impact optimization opportunities, establish frameworks to measure performance, and translate technical improvements into financial outcomes. This is a great role for folks who have an interest in how AI research intersects with compute. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Partner with Inference researchers, Scaling, Product, and Data Science teams to identify, evaluate, and prioritize optimization opportunities, weighing customer and economic trade-offs across model performance, latency, throughput, engagement, and compute cost. Drive cross-functional strategic initiatives to improve inference efficiency by establishing clear ownership, coordinating work across teams, and tracking execution progress. Establish key performance metrics, dashboards, and analytical frameworks to identify inference performance gaps and quantify the financial impact of improvements. Partner with Compute Finance and other Strategic Finance teams to incorporate expected inference efficiency improvements into long-term compute demand forecasts, capacity planning, investment decisions and financial projections. You might thrive in this role if you have: A technical academic background (e.g., computer science, engineering, or mathematics) or current experience partnering closely with research or engineering teams on technical problems. 8–10+ years of experience in management consulting, strategy & operations, strategic finance, or a related analytical role. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with a track record of turning ambiguous problems into actionable recommendations and measurable impact. Executive presence and communication skills to build credibility with researchers and engineers, align stakeholders, and explain technical and financial trade-offs. Technical curiosity and enthusiasm for frontier AI and inference economics. Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, cloud computing, or technical performance optimization is a plus, but not required. The ChatGPT team works across research, engineering, product, and design to bring OpenAI’s technology to the world. We serve a diverse audience of users who are already using ChatGPT daily in their lives and work. We seek to learn from deployment and distribute the benefits of AI, while ensuring that this powerful tool is used responsibly and safely. Safety is more important to us than unfettered growth. About the role We’re looking for a Content Designer to join OpenAI’s Content Design team, bringing deep expertise in prompt engineering and AI evaluation alongside strong content design craft and product judgment. You’ll combine editorial judgment, product strategy, and technical implementation to build prompts, evaluations, and tools that help us create and improve content and messaging at scale. Your primary focus will be experiences that help people discover ChatGPT’s value, get started, and stay engaged—including notifications—with contributions to broader Content Design work as team needs evolve. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Shape content strategy for experiences that help people discover ChatGPT’s value, get started, and return to meaningful uses of the product. Design, implement, and iterate on prompt frameworks that guide AI-generated product content and messaging. Define content quality standards and build evaluation systems, datasets, and reviewer guidance that combine human judgment with automated assessments. Shape tools and workflows for generating, reviewing, and improving content across experiments and product experiences. Analyze model outputs and evaluation results to diagnose problems and improve content systems as models, products, and user needs evolve. Partner with product, engineering, design, research, and data science to connect content quality with user understanding, trust, engagement, and retention. Document reusable approaches and coach other Content Designers in developing prompts, defining evaluation criteria, and interpreting results. You might thrive in this role if you: Bring 5+ years of experience in content design, content engineering, or a related discipline, with a track record of delivering work across complex product areas. Have hands-on experience developing prompts for shipped generative AI experiences and understand model capabilities, limitations, and failure patterns. Have designed and implemented content evaluation frameworks—and validated how reliably they assess quality. Have hands-on experience using code and APIs to build repeatable generation and evaluation workflows, and can partner with Engineering to integrate them into production. Bring strong writing, editorial judgment, and content strategy skills that you can apply across product experiences. Can turn qualitative and quantitative evidence into clear recommendations and demonstrate how your work improved content quality, team effectiveness, or product outcomes. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We believe our research will eventually lead to artificial general intelligence, a system that can solve human-level problems. The Community & Culture Engagement team helps people discover, use, and advocate for OpenAI’s tools through community programs, social storytelling, creator partnerships, and cultural experiences. Our work connects OpenAI with the people and communities who bring its technology into everyday life. As the team grows across disciplines and markets, we need shared foundations that connect our work, make priorities clear, and help us deliver with speed and care. About the Role We’re looking for a senior operations leader to own Community & Culture’s integrated operating model. You will build and own the infrastructure that enables the team to operate as one and execute at a consistently high standard. You are accountable for keeping the plans funded, staffed and executable as priorities change. You will establish the shared practices, clear accountability, and reliable information that allow leaders to make sound decisions and teams to deliver on their commitments. This is a senior leadership role that combines organizational judgment with hands-on building. Working closely with Community & Culture leadership and partners across OpenAI, you will turn strategy into practical operating plans, anticipate risks, and guide decisions about where we invest and how we staff the work. You will build systems people trust and use, adapting them as priorities and the organization evolve. This role is based in San Francisco, CA or New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Establish and own Community and Culture’s integrated operating model. This includes overseeing and building practical tools and workflows for financial management, resourcing, and operating reviews. Own the team’s financial operating system. In partnership with Finance, Marketing, Partnerships and Comms leads, establish a consistent approach to budgeting, forecasting, spend approvals, and reporting across central and international teams. Maintain a trusted view of planned, committed, and actual spend. Responsible for driving tradeoff decisions, investment shifts and reallocation where needed. Establish clear governance across the team. Define decision rights, build and own approval processes, clarify program ownership and appropriate handoffs to partner teams, and create clear escalation paths across the team. Lead resourcing and capacity planning. Translate priorities into plans for full time, freelance, and agency remits. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

descriptionAr: Who are we? Our mission is to scale intelligence to serve humanity. We’re training and deploying frontier models for developers and enterprises who are building AI systems to power magical experiences like content generation, semantic search, RAG, and agents. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. We like to work hard and move fast to do what’s best for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are passionate about their craft. Each person is one of the best in the world at what they do. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives is a requirement for building great products. Join us on our mission and shape the future! Why this role? We are on a mission to build machines that understand the world and make them safely accessible to all. Data quality is foundational to this process. Machines (or Large Language Models to be exact) learn in similar ways to humans - by way of feedback. By labelling, ranking, auditing, and correcting text output, you will improve Large Language Model’s performance for iterations to come, thus having a lasting impact on Cohere’s tech. Cohere seeks dynamic and dedicated Data Annotators with exceptional Modern Standard German Writing, Translation, and Data Manipulation skill. Please Note: This is a part-time independent contractor position available within Canada . We seek candidates who are able to commit to 16 hours per week minimum at a 30 CAD/hour contract rate. This role is BYOD 💻 - Bring Your Own Device (laptop). Remote work within Canada. 12 months contract. Performance incentives included! As a Data Annotation Specialist, you will: Label and Rank: Accurately label and rank machine learning data with advanced proficiency in German, ensuring data integrity and quality. Audit and Correct: Scrutinize and rectify any inaccuracies in language data (may include text, image, JSON, TSV/CSV, Markdown), maintaining the highest standard of data accuracy. Reading and Text-Based Tasks: Efficiently complete reading and text-based assignments, with high attention to detail. Preference-Based Tasks: Evaluate and complete tasks, assessing which responses in German best conform to project guidelines. Recommend Optimizations: Identify and suggest opportunities for improving data quality and model performance in German language tasks. Provide Feedback: Collaborate and communicate effectively, providing feedback to cross-functional team members, particularly on German language-related matters. Detail-Oriented Execution: Maintain meticulous attention to detail while performing repetitive and precise tasks, particularly when working with language data. You may be a good fit if you have: Language Proficiency: Native or near-native proficiency in German; excellent command over English. Expert reading and writing skills - which you are ready to prove on our written test. Basic familiarity with JSON/TSV/CSV/Markdown data manipulation. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy - you’re the type to proofread all of your emails! High tolerance for repetitive and monotonous work. Ability to follow complex instructions, navigate ambiguity and work independently. Superb sense of urgency and time management. Curiosity about technology and a knack for tackling problems in creative ways. A reliable laptop. The Candidate Journey: Initial Screening - Once you have submitted your application our Talent Team will review your resume and writing samples. Virtual Annotation Test - This assignment will test your written skill through various language-based tasks, such as a a writing sample, interacting with a chat bot, and more. Video Screen - If selected to move forward, you will have a short video call with a member of our Operations Team! Offer - Independent Contractor Agreement As an independent contractor, you maintain control over how you complete your work and may work with multiple clients simultaneously, although we ask you to declare if any of these are with a direct competitor of Cohere and maintain IP confidentiality of the Cohere project. Independent contractors are not eligible for health benefits or other benefits provided to employees. Compensation for services is provided to contractors by contractors invoicing for services provided pursuant to the terms of our agreement with the contractor. It is important to understand that as an independent contractor, continuous work is not guaranteed . descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s Tax and Trade team sits at the center of OpenAI’s global growth, shaping how cutting-edge AI products, partnerships, and infrastructure scale across borders while navigating complex tax, trade, and regulatory regimes. We operate as strategic operators, not just compliance experts, embedding early in product, finance, policy, and infrastructure decisions to manage risk, unlock incentives, and enable OpenAI to grow responsibly and competitively worldwide. About the Role We’re hiring a Tax Director to advise on OpenAI’s global tax strategy and support the company’s continued international expansion. This role will partner closely with Legal, Finance, Corporate Development, and commercial teams on cross-border tax planning, operating model design, market entry, strategic partnerships, product launches, intercompany arrangements, and complex commercial transactions. You will bring deep international tax expertise and practical business judgment to help OpenAI move quickly while managing risk across a rapidly evolving global footprint. The role requires someone who can translate complex tax rules into clear recommendations, build scalable frameworks, and operate as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across the company. You’ll be responsible for: Support tax aspects of strategic transactions, including acquisitions, joint ventures, reorganizations, divestitures, and post-close integration, in partnership with Corporate Development, Legal, and Finance. Advise on international tax planning and global operating model design, including legal entity footprint, intercompany arrangements, IP ownership and use, customer contracting models, and cross-border service flows. Serve as a core tax business partner for global expansion initiatives, including new market entry, changes in operating footprint, and regional business scaling. Advise Product, Legal, Finance, and commercial teams on tax considerations for go-to-market motions, strategic partnerships, customer contracting, and new revenue models. Evaluate permanent establishment, withholding tax, treaty, source and character, transfer pricing, and other international tax considerations arising from global business activity. Monitor US and international tax law and policy developments, including Pillar Two and other global tax reform initiatives, and assess implications for OpenAI’s business planning and operating model. Advise on tax aspects of financing and treasury initiatives, including intercompany funding, capital structure planning, and third-party financings. Manage external advisors and coordinate internal stakeholders to deliver timely, practical, and high-quality tax advice across business initiatives. Build scalable frameworks, playbooks, and processes that enable consistent, repeatable tax advisory for a fast-growing global business. Communicate complex tax issues clearly to non-tax stakeholders, including senior leadership, and help drive decisions that balance tax efficiency, risk management, operational feasibility, and business priorities. We’re looking for someone with: A J.D. and strong academic credentials; LL.M. in Taxation a plus. 12+ years of progressive international tax experience, ideally with a mix of law firm and in-house experience at a high-growth multinational business. Strong foundation in complex domestic and cross-border M&A, joint ventures, reorganizations, and post-acquisition integrations. Extensive experience advising on cross-border commercial arrangements, market entry, strategic partnerships, and international expansion. Deep technical expertise in US international tax, including GILTI, FDII, BEAT, foreign tax credits, withholding tax, tax treaties, source and character of income, Subpart F, and permanent establishment principles. Strong understanding of transfer pricing principles, intercompany arrangements, IP planning, and global operating model design. Experience with Pillar Two and global tax policy developments, and ability to translate legislative change into practical business advice. Proven ability to distill complex tax concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for non-tax stakeholders and executive leadership. Exceptional judgment, presence, and communication skills; comfortable operating at senior levels of the organization. Track record of building trust and credibility across Legal, Finance, Product, Infrastructure, Corporate Development, and commercial teams. Workplace & Location This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote opportunity and we're interested in candidates based in the US or Canada. Residents of Quebec are not eligible for this role. Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, Grafana Data Source Plugins The Opportunity: As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer in the Grafana Data Source Plugins squad, you will take a leading role in developing and enhancing a diverse portfolio of data source plugins that retrieve the data powering Grafana dashboards used by teams worldwide.  Our team focuses on continuously improving data source plugins, ensuring seamless experience for human and agent users alike. A key aspect of this role is guaranteeing the smooth operation and reliability of our plugins in the Grafana Cloud, helping us deliver on our commitment to world-class observability tools.  What You’ll Be Doing:  Some data source plugins we own:  Prometheus, Loki, Infinity, MySQL, PostgreSQL, AWS Cloudwatch, and Clickhouse.  The full catalog is listed here . A typical “day in the life” could include:  Building or improving Grafana plugins to integrate third party services or databases into Grafana  Supporting the operations and reliability of our plugins in Grafana Cloud Coming up with suggestions for process improvements Integrating data sources with agentic workflows such as Grafana Assistant Providing technical support in customer escalations  Working closely with the rest of the Grafana Division What Makes You a Great Fit: You know how to transform ideas into working code, you are able to design a solution, get feedback and deliver large projects. You are a self-driven individual who understands the power of feedback loops in making roadmap decisions and driving our product forward. You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action, and willing to take on any challenge You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs. You are an excellent communicator and you enjoy collaboration You are comfortable working in a remote-first company Requirements: Solid experience with Golang & Typescript Experience with Kubernetes & microservices Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others Experience participating in an on-call rotation and performing operations/SRE tasks Bonus Points For: You have been a user of Grafana and Grafana Data Sources You have expertise in one of the underlying databases we support You have strong experience working with a Product Manager or external stakeholders In the United States, the Base compensation range for this role is CAD $ 164,490 - $197,389 .  Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here . #LI-Remote #LI-Remote *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture -  As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.  Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment id

descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations Austin, US San Francisco, US New York City, US London, UK About the Role Cloudforce One is Cloudflare’s threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs).  Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.  Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world’s largest global networks can provide.  The team is able to analyze these unique data points, at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will own the entire software development lifecycle—from design and architecture to deployment and monitoring—for systems that serve both threat disruption and legal response efforts. You will be responsible for translating complex legal and security requirements into robust, scalable, and high-performance applications that have a direct impact on making the internet better, safer, and more powerful every day. Responsibilities While the majority of our services are now written in Golang and TypeScript, you will also work with technologies such as Rust, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform, Temporal and PostgresSQL. We also pride ourselves in dogfooding our own products and services so you will be extensively working with Cloudflare’s developer platform as well. We are looking for great engineers regardless of experience with any of these specific technologies. This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed. Design, build, run, and scale distributed tools and services that support both cyber threat disruption and platform abuse efforts. Develop critical data pipelines and services to collect, analyze, and expose threat intelligence data for Cloudforce One analysts and Cloudflare customers, helping to identify Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) and Indicators of Compromise (IOCs). Collaborate closely with Threat Intelligence, Trust & Safety, Legal, and Product teams to understand goals and translate complex technical requirements into elegant, scalable solutions. Improve system design and architecture to ensure stability, performance, and maintainability of both internal and customer-facing compliance and security services. Analyze, communicate, and help prioritize complex technical concepts across teams. Ongoing monitoring and maintenance of production services, including participation in on-call rotations. Mentor and guide other developers in the team, helping to build collective technical expertise and promote best practices for writing well-tested, modular, and reusable code. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Experience with AI-assisted development and agentic AI workflows At least 5 years of experience building large-scale software applications, preferably distributed systems At least 3 years of experience working with Threat Intelligence or in support of a Threat Intelligence platform Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and/or gRPC services Knowledge of SQL and common relational database systems such as PostgreSQL Prior experience writing production ready code in Go and/or Typescript Familiarity with Rust Excellent debugging and optimization skills Expertise in writing well tested code Interest in opportunities to be a technical mentor for teammates Bonus Points Deep understanding of DNS, TLS/SSL and HTTP Expertise in web security issues and industry standards for access control Experience with Kafka Experience building web applications using React Experience with Kubernetes Experience with Redis Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - $216,000 For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $206,000 Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. descriptionAr: About the Role Lead OpenAI’s field delivery of civil works, structures, building envelope, architectural fit-out and landscape interfaces, from site preparation through completed facilities. You will be OpenAI’s accountable on-site lead for civil, structural, landscape and architectural construction, directing and overseeing the work of general contractors, specialist contractors and other service providers within your discipline. You will combine practical subject-matter depth with hands-on field leadership, managing contracted support to deliver safe, high-quality work to the integrated construction plan. Reporting and scope Report to the Site Construction Manager, who reports through the applicable project-management leadership. Coordinate design interpretation and technical decisions with the responsible civil, structural and architectural engineers. Own day-to-day discipline execution and contractor performance within the assigned site scope and delegated authority. Coordinate priorities and interfaces through the Site Construction Manager; escalate material cost, schedule, design and acceptance decisions to the appropriate owners. This is a senior site delivery role, suited to an experienced superintendent, supervisor, manager or trade lead. Accountability is for an assigned discipline and site work packages. Site assignment, duration and any shared coverage follow project phase, workload and the staffing plan; effective on-site coverage is required during critical activities. Key Responsibilities Direct and coordinate general contractors, civil and structural trades, architectural contractors and specialist service providers against the approved design, construction schedule and quality requirements. Oversee earthworks, grading, drainage, underground interfaces, foundations, concrete, structural steel, building envelope and architectural completion; coordinate landscape and external works. Review constructability, work sequencing, contractor work plans, RFIs, submittals and proposed changes; obtain design decisions from the responsible engineers and track field implementation. Coordinate building and underground interfaces with mechanical, electrical and network leads and hardware deployment teams, protecting access, equipment routes and installation readiness. Inspect work with quality teams, track nonconformances and punch lists, and verify contractor closeout, as-built records and turnover readiness. Set clear contractor deliverables and work priorities; review staffing, progress and quality, identify constraints early, and drive recovery actions through the Site Construction Manager. Provide concise progress and risk reporting, evaluate field impacts of proposed changes, and maintain accountable handoffs between construction partners and OpenAI teams. Qualifications Typically 8–10 years of civil, structural or architectural construction experience, including substantial data center or comparable complex industrial site delivery and responsibility for contractors or multiple work packages. Equivalent depth of practical delivery experience will be considered. Ability to read and coordinate civil, structural and architectural drawings, specifications, surveys and relevant geotechnical information, recognizing impacts on grading, drainage, earthworks, foundations, underground services and building construction. Experience translating approved designs into buildable field packages, sequencing, temporary-work interfaces and inspection hold points; assess utility conflicts, equipment access and phased handover before releasing work. Experience reviewing RFIs, submittals and field changes, coordinating design decisions with the engineer of record, and verifying approved changes in the field while preserving clear design responsibility. Practical knowledge of inspection and acceptance evidence for civil works, concrete, steel, building envelope and architectural completion, including nonconformance resolution, punch lists and as-built records. Ability to coordinate construction with permitting conditions, environmental constraints and authorities having jurisdiction through the responsible engineering and EHS teams. Demonstrated ability to lead contractors and service providers through changing site conditions, set clear deliverables and acceptance criteria, and resolve performance gaps across organizations without relying on direct reporting authority. Strong written and verbal communication: maintain accurate field records, action and decision logs, and explain technical risks, schedule impacts and recovery options to site leadership, engineers and delivery partners. Sound judgment when information is incomplete: identify assumptions, prerequisites and interfaces, determine what work can proceed within approved authority, and escalate unresolved risks before they affect safety, quality or delivery. Relevant trade, apprenticeship, technical or degree-based preparation, or equivalent practical experience. Demonstrated field leadership and subject-matter competence are central to this site role. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. This is a hands-on role for a thoughtful lawyer who enjoys variety, moves quickly, and wants to help build a strong employment legal function as the business scales. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Location:  Preferred Locations: San Francisco, Austin, NYC OR Remote About the Role  Cloudflare’s GTM organization is scaling rapidly, and its RevOps tech stack must scale with it. We are hiring a RevOps Technologist to shape future-state workflows and move our RevOps technology roadmap from strategy and prototype toward secure, scalable execution. This senior individual contributor will combine deep Sales and Revenue Operations expertise with the hands-on technical fluency to identify strategic solutions and simplified workflows. You'll report directly to the Director of RevTech Strategy & Operations, and be the senior counterpart to our business partners, IT, Procurement, Engineering, Security & Privacy, to ensure our systems are optimized, and governed. You will transform our rapidly scaling, today’s fragmented tech stack into a secure, orchestrated engine, across vendor platforms, internal tooling, and Cloudflare’s internal orchestration platform (Cloudflare OS). You will set the direction for Build/Buy/Blend opportunities, prototype AI- and automation-enabled capabilities, and partner with IT and Engineering to move validated solutions toward production. You will bring an end-to-end view across workflows, systems, data and integrations, to reduce complexity and elevate the seller experience while balancing technical feasibility with business value.  We are looking for someone who doesn't just manage the existing RevOps stack, but actively reimagines a scalable, best-in-class stack with a stellar seller experience. If you thrive on challenging the status quo, hands-on building with cutting-edge technology, and turning bold GTM ideas into high-impact reality, we want to talk to you. What You’ll Do: Shape the Future of RevTech & GTM Systems Drive the AI-first RevOps technology roadmap across internal systems, Cloudflare OS, vendor platforms, and new build opportunities, to improve seller efficiency and effectiveness. Identify where the stack needs to scale, simplify, or modernize based on jobs-to-be-done, user needs, and workflow friction points. Connect technology decisions across the broader GTM ecosystem (workflows, systems, data, integrations, and dependencies) rather than optimizing individual tools in isolation. Apply AI, agents, automation, and emerging technologies to practical opportunities that reduce friction, and modernize GTM operations. Document current state-workflows, systems, dependencies and pain points to identify exactly where the stack needs to scale or simplify, and translate findings into clear future-state designs and recommendations. Design, Prototype & Automate Translate sales capabilities “jobs-to-be-done", workflow context, and user needs into clear technology requirements and solution approaches balancing user experience, scalability, and technical feasibility. Architect solutions across the RevTech landscape that work cohesively with existing CRM, sales engagement, forecasting, data, and other seller technologies. Leverage Cloudflare OS, AI, agents, and automation to prototype and build secure solutions, validating where tech adds value vs. human judgement is required. Partner with IT and Engineering to move validated solutions toward production, aligning on the APIs, MCPs, integrations, and security. Drive Technology & Investment Strategy Advise on build, buy, blend, or retire decisions based on time-to-value, scalability, security, cost, and flexibility. Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary SaaS dependency, utilizing Cloudflare OS or internal capabilities where appropriate. Bring a technical and strategic lens to technology investments, partnering with Procurement, Software Asset Management, IT, and business stakeholders to evaluate vendors and inform a ROI-backed roadmap investments. Own Governance & Systems Standards Define governance, intake models, and decision guardrails for RevTech and AI use cases. Participate in cross-functional AI initiatives to evaluate, prioritize, and scale AI-enabled seller workflows. Establish auditable RevTech change controls with clear governance based on risk and impact. Ensure vendors and internal builds comply with security, privacy, data, and AI standards. Strategic Partnership & Communications Build trusted relationships across GTM, tech teams, business partners and vendors as a trusted advisor on priorities, trade-offs, and future-state direction. Own Replit’s strategic positioning: the upstream frameworks and intellectual capital that make every launch, stage, and story land better. Lead communications programs across company announcements, product launches, enterprise momentum, customer stories, partnerships, policy-related issues, executive visibility, awards, events, and thought leadership. The team defines the technical direction for next-generation data centers and develops the architectures needed to support rapidly evolving AI hardware and workload requirements. Operating at the intersection of research, engineering, infrastructure, and deployment, the team translates emerging compute requirements into validated electrical designs, reference architectures, prototypes, and scalable infrastructure solutions. About the Role We are seeking an experienced Data Center Electrical R&D Engineer to develop and validate next-generation power architectures for high-density AI infrastructure. This role is focused on research, advanced design, modeling, prototyping, and technical validation rather than ongoing facility operations. You will investigate emerging electrical technologies, develop system-level architectures, and evaluate new approaches to utility integration, power distribution, backup generation, energy storage, controls, and rack-level power delivery. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations:  Austin (US), London (UK) Role Summary As a Product Security Engineer, you will support security assessments and vulnerability operations for Cloudflare’s core software products. In this role, you will analyze system architecture, threat model new features, and ensure that product-related security findings are accurately triaged, routed to the correct engineering owners, and mitigated within our SLAs. On any given day, you might conduct a deep-dive security review on a new feature design, triage a complex bug bounty submission, or work directly with engineering teams to resolve vulnerabilities from different sources like bug bounties, SAST, fuzzing and penetration tests. You will also work autonomously to identify areas where our manual processes slow down. You will write code and integrate AI/LLM solutions to automate initial triage and data enrichment, building tools that help the team handle security findings at scale. In short, your work will sit at the intersection of Product Security, Vulnerability Operations, and internal AI Tooling. Ideally, you have experience in conducting academic/vulnerability research with a focus on systems security. Ensure vulnerabilities are verified, mapped to the correct engineering owner, and tracked to mitigation in alignment with established SLAs. Bug Bounty Triage: Perform the technical triage and validation of Cloudflare’s external Bug Bounty submissions, verifying exploitability and evaluating business risk. Pentest Coordination: Support internal and external penetration testing engagements by reviewing findings, clarifying technical context, and assisting development teams with remediation strategies. Engineering Collaboration: Partner closely with DevOps and product teams, acting as a reliable security point of contact and helping developers implement secure coding practices. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Product/AppSec Expertise: 5+ years of experience in Product or Application Security within large-scale distributed cloud environments or SaaS platforms. Practical AI & Automation Engineering: Demonstrated ability to build production-grade automation scripts and tools. Strong Collaboration & Communication: Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, clearly communicating technical security risks to software engineers and resolving ownership ambiguity constructively. Program Management Experience: Experience scaling crowdsourced security programs (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd) or optimizing agile project management workflows within JIRA. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada. The Opportunity: Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. Foundations produces the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP) and partners closely with our Cloud, Enterprise, and Grafana teams. Our team develops the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations. We utilize the grafana.com platform to engineer bespoke integrations and solutions that unify the diverse technical ecosystem of a modern software enterprise. The team owns important domain areas that help keep both our customer workflows and internal business processes running smoothly. AppCore is made up of multiple squads, each focused on one or more of these domains. Our work includes maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculations, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the user portal our customers rely on to manage their accounts. This is a team working at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. The systems we build are critical to how Grafana Cloud scales. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex workflow and systems problems, improving reliability and developer experience, and building software that directly supports both customers and internal stakeholders. As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. Engineers at Grafana Labs also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities and collaborate across teams beyond their immediate scope. What You’ll Be Doing: The Usage squad owns the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations and customer usage calculations. Our domain encompasses maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculation, cost management and billing applications, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the customer user portal. Our work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. We build full-stack web applications, customer portals, backend services, APIs, and data integrations across internal Grafana platforms and third-party systems like NetSuite and Salesforce. When this domain works well, customers get clear usage visibility, reliable billing, and seamless account management workflows. This role is about 75% FrontEnd and 25% BackEnd. Design, build, operate, and evolve reliable full-stack web applications, customer-facing account portals, and backend services that power core customer usage and billing workflows Build and maintain backend APIs (Golang, Node.js) and intuitive user interfaces using modern frontend technologies (TypeScript, React) Design and maintain integrations between Grafana systems and external business platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, and cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP) Develop and automate business logic for customer usage metering, pricing structures, promotions, and billing reconciliation Collaborate across product management, DealOps, GTM, Support, and adjacent AppCore squads to deliver robust end-to-end features Address technical debt, optimize CI/CD pipelines, strengthen test coverage, and improve system observability and operational resilience Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers while shaping pragmatic solutions for complex systems challenges Contribute to roadmap planning, technical design, OnCall improvements, and long-term simplification of stack operations You will help own the production behavior of the systems you build. That includes improving runbooks, dashboards, alerts, reconciliation safety, rollout controls, and recovery procedures. You should be comfortable debugging across service boundaries and making careful changes in systems that affect customer stacks What Makes You a Great Fit: At Grafana, we actively embrace AI-assisted and agentic development practices, integrating these technologies into both our engineering workflows and the systems we deliver. Improve the correctness and reliability of billing and usage workflows, including validation, reconciliation, error handling and recovery. descriptionAr: About Lemon.io Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. We’ve been in business for 10 years, have 60 people across Ukraine, Europe, Canada, and the US, and process over $16M in annual GMV. We compress the traditional 2–5 week hiring timeline down to 24–48 hours through a curated, pre-vetted supply of developers. Hiring is still broken. Recruiters spend weeks building candidate pipelines on traditional platforms, burning energy on unqualified leads. We’re building the product that changes that. Giving recruiters qualified, vetted candidates within 24 hours without the grind. This is a pivotal moment: we’re transitioning from a services-driven marketplace to a technology-driven platform. We need an engineering leader who can drive that transformation. The Role You will own engineering at Lemon.io . You’ll lead a growing team of engineers, make critical architecture and prioritization decisions, and be directly accountable for the speed and quality of what we ship. This is not a management-layer role. You’ll be hands-on, deeply involved in product decisions, and working side by side with the founder. What You’ll Do: Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake. Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost. Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is. Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill. Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code. Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy. Who You Are: Product-minded, business-first Obsessed with simplicity First principles thinker Fast. Bias toward action Experience: You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company. You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling. You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team. Why Lemon.io : Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals. A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open. Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship. A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers. A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

descriptionAr: About PostHog PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it. We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort . We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including: A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics , replay vision , AI observability , and error tracking PostHog MCP for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data Data warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights. We are: Product-led . More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit. Default alive . Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey. We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible . Things we care about Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook . Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions. Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams and make product decisions . Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed. Shipping fast: Why not now? We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end. Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days , and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had. Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun. What you'll be doing ClickHouse is the core piece of infrastructure at PostHog . Every product and customer relies on it to ingest, store, and query data. We need someone to automate, manage, and maintain ClickHouse as we grow towards capturing trillions of events per year and having one of the world’s largest clusters.
